text.p: Tropical storm Opal has moved back over water after having crossed Honshu during the past 24 hours. The track took the system close to Tokyo where the airport reported winds of 50 mph sustained and wind gusts of 65 mph. Heavy rain was also reported in the region. The coast of south Honshu likely had a strong storm surge and very high winds when the system moved across the coastline. Heavy rains in southeast Honshu contributed to flooding. Wind damage is also likely through the area. Conditions improve rapidly during the next 6 hours as the system moves rapidly away from the area.
